verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an ATS SaaS like Lever, so the axis applies. The pack only shows API list endpoints (applications, deleted applications, audit events), which are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export. Nothing documents a first-party full-data export in open formats or an offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
